name: Nathan (David's son)
title: Son of David, link in Jesus' genealogy
summary: Nathan was one of David's sons born in Jerusalem to Bathsheba, and brother to Solomon. According to Luke's genealogy, Jesus' lineage went through Nathan, not through Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Nathan was among the sons David had in Jerusalem with Bathsheba, along with Shimea, Shobab and Solomon.
